example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি এভাবে বেহায়াপনা করলে পাখির ডানা গজাবে!
এই কাজটা করে সে নিজেই পাখির ডানা গজিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: If you keep being so shameless, you'll sprout bird's wings!
By doing that, he has qualified for ridicule himself.
note: This idiom uses bird imagery common in Bengali folklore to convey sarcasm about overambition or foolishness leading to mockery.
